purpose: Build 17 started on a real iPhone and QA filed five defects against it. Three are fixed here: a peer whose fields were all cleared is now absent-where-absent instead of empty-string, which is the shape the original profile card crashed on; replies carry the original ReplyMessageAttribute through the document; and the profile editor's birthday and avatar join the name and bio in completing locally instead of waiting on a network request that never answers. The two remaining defects are upstream behaviour and are deliberately untouched.
